concepts.title: Status Hierarchy and the Pecking Order
concepts.excerpt: Every human group develops a status hierarchy. Some are explicit (military ranks, job titles) and most are implicit (who defers to whom, whose opinion is sought, who initiates and who responds).

concepts.title: The Performance of Power
concepts.excerpt: Power is not possessed; it is performed. The person who acts as if they have power accumulates actual power because observers treat the performance as reality.

concepts.title: The Use of Flattery and Strategic Appreciation
concepts.excerpt: Everyone wants to be appreciated. The person who gives appreciation gains leverage over those who receive it.
